Definition: What proportion of the population does the register cover?
Comments: UBOS Vital Statistics Report 2024 reports birth registration completeness for under-1 live births in 2024 at 3.4% and death registration completeness at 3.9%, which is <20% coverage category.

Chapter Details: Status of national population, civil, address, land, business, electoral, tax and social protection registers. 44 variables in 8 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: What proportion of land ownership does the register cover?
Comments: No authoritative nationwide percentage of land formally registered was found; available evidence highlights that ~80% of Uganda’s landholdings are customary and the move to digitize Certificates of Customary Ownership suggests much of customary land is not yet in the formal land register, implying low formal coverage (<20%).

Definition: What proportion of businesses does the register cover?
Comments: No direct proportion of all businesses registered for tax was found; IMF PFM blog notes URA registered over 350,000 informal taxpayers by 2022 and EFRIS focuses on VAT-registered businesses, implying overall business taxpayer coverage remains low relative to total enterprises (many informal), assessed as <20%.

Definition: What proportion of individual taxpayers does the register cover?
Comments: No direct national share of individual taxpayers registered was found; IMF PFM blog notes URA registered over 350,000 informal taxpayers by 2022, which is small relative to Uganda’s population, suggesting low individual taxpayer coverage (<20%).
